full_prompt_en: A square highly detailed historical fantasy illustration shows a tightly packed gathering of bearded warriors in ornate dress and armor. The crowd fills the frame edge to edge, with almost no open background. In the lower left foreground, an older man with a long silver beard wears a red and gold decorated helmet and a richly patterned teal garment. He looks toward the left, his pale beard flowing across his chest. Slightly behind him near the center, another broad bearded figure in a warm brown turban raises a hand above his eyes as if looking into the distance. A smaller figure in a deep blue cap and patterned red collar occupies the lower right, turning toward the central group. Behind them, faces, helmets, patterned head wraps, shields, and raised weapons overlap in many shallow layers. One long pale blade rises diagonally near the upper middle, providing a clear directional line through the densely woven details. Warm cream faces and gray beards are interspersed with saturated red, lapis blue, bronze, olive, and ocher textiles. Every visible garment and metal surface carries fine scrolling motifs, seams, or hammered marks, yet the strongest outlines keep the foreground profiles distinct. The square is bounded by a pale printed margin that separates the richly colored illustration from the outer white field. Soft even illumination makes small details legible throughout, while deeper brown shadow sits between heads and below overlapping forms. The overall composition is crowded, ceremonial, and energetic, using miniature like precision and many interlocking gestures to create the sense of a large story compressed into a single image.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形细节丰富的历史奇幻插画描绘一群身穿华丽服装与盔甲的蓄须武士紧密聚集。人群从边到边填满画面，几乎没有空背景。左下前景，一名长银须老人戴红金装饰头盔，穿花纹繁复的青绿色服装。他朝左望去，浅色胡须垂过胸前。后方略靠中央，另一名戴暖棕色头巾、蓄宽大胡须的人举手遮在眼上，仿佛望向远方。右下方一名戴深蓝帽、穿红色花纹领饰的较小人物朝中央人群转身。其后，面孔、头盔、花纹头巾、盾牌和举起的兵器在许多浅层次里互相遮叠。一柄长而浅色的刃在上方中部附近斜向升起，为密织的细节提供明确方向线。暖奶油色面孔与灰胡须穿插在饱和红、青金蓝、古铜、橄榄与赭色织物间。每件可见的衣料与金属表面都有细小卷饰、接缝或锤打痕，最强的轮廓仍让前景侧脸清楚分开。方形图像由浅色印刷留边包围，使丰厚彩图与外侧白色区域分开。柔和均匀的光让各处小细节可读，较深棕色阴影停在头部之间和重叠形体下方。整体构图拥挤、有仪式感且充满动势，以细密画般的精确和大量咬合动作，把宏大的故事压缩进单一画面。
style_prompt_en: Highly detailed decorative illustration packs many overlapping forms into a shallow square space, leaving very little blank ground. Fine dark outlines, tiny scrollwork, patterned color bands, and engraved marks remain distinct even within dense clusters. Warm parchment, ivory, ocher, bronze, deep red, teal, and lapis blue alternate in small areas, creating a jewel like rhythm without a single dominant flat fill. Larger light silhouettes and a few diagonal accents organize the multitude of miniature details. Edges are mostly crisp, while soft brown shadows in narrow gaps keep adjacent layers from collapsing together. Illumination is broad and even, allowing ornaments across the frame to remain legible rather than isolating one spotlight. The surface feels printed or meticulously painted, with intricate linework visible at close range. The overall effect is crowded but ordered, richly ceremonial in color and animated by repeating curves and crossing directions.
style_prompt_zh: 高度细致的装饰性插画将许多重叠形状压入较浅的方形空间，几乎不给空白地面。细深轮廓、小卷饰、花纹色带和雕刻般痕迹即使在密集成组之处仍各自清楚。暖纸色、象牙白、赭色、古铜、深红、青绿与青金蓝在小区域交替，形成宝石般节奏，而不由单一平色主导。较大的浅色剪影和少量斜向重音组织数量繁多的微小细节。边缘大体清晰，狭窄缝隙中的柔和棕色阴影避免邻接层次塌成一片。照明宽广均匀，让整幅的装饰都可辨，而非只照亮一处。表面像精细印刷或仔细绘成，近看可见复杂线条。整体效果拥挤却有秩序，色彩华丽而有仪式感，重复曲线与交叉方向带来活力。
theme_en: A dense gathering of richly dressed bearded warriors
theme_zh: 一群身着华丽衣甲的蓄须武士密集聚在一起
name: Arthur Szyk
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
